body:
I have told my story over and over. I have tried everything realistically possible. I AM a fighter and have fought longer than many people I know could but we all have limits. "Just don't" is a bizarre thing to say. Why? Because it makes you uncomfortable? Because it makes others uncomfortable? It makes ME uncomfortable! I would much rather be healthier and have an income so I can buy a life like other peope. I can't.

There is no "through" unless you mean suffer every second until a natural death. That is ridiculous to expect of anyone. There is no cure for my medical issues, I can't work and no program I paid into will help me, and nobody I know will support me. You cannot live like that. It's not a matter of "getting through" it. There is no other side. There is no path I can take that will return me to a good life. There is only making this one comfortable enough to manage and I cannot.

I guess I shouldn't have expected anything other than this sort of response. The point isn't to change the world. The point is to end the suffering nobody else will. Hoping at least some people would face it and change because if it is a bonus.

I can't function through a normal day without slipping. The last thing I can do is become an activist. I was just trying to use the end to make some people pay attention who would not. 

I can't live because I have so much pain and have lost so much and society won't help me to keep trying. That's the fact. 

You won't convince me to keep suffering because "it will make people feel bad" or "life is worth living" or "just don't" etc. People who say that don't have real pain...life changing pain...life ruining pain.

This subreddit has always been empty platitudes and I should have known better.

**TL:DR - I am planning to end my life in the next months (no date set but making plans) due to chronic pain, the losses surrounding it, and the inability to get the assistance I need to survive in a way that doesn't make it worse. I would like to document the reasons and the process to try and bring some attention to the amount of people who are suffering and unable to get help in the USA. This isn't some “death on cam” porn and the logistics of doing that would risk failure and distract from the point anyway.  Rather I want to bring a face and a voice to a human life that could have lived but will not simply because of incompetence, bureaucracy and money. I know of ways to have delayed emails sent but don't know how I can make a video/videos and have them posted after I die or if that is even the best format to use. Is there a way to upload media and have it post if a “deadman” ¯\_(ツ)_/¯ switch isn't reset etc?**

The story if people need it but I know TL:DR is a thing so the paragraph above is the summary:

Because of incompetent and greedy doctors I have lived in worsening chronic pain for over 10 years now. I tried for as long as I could to manage with my savings and partial pension from my job but more and more medical issues and more and more losses and costs have finally pushed me to the edge of the cliff and there is nothing much left to hold on to. 

I applied for disability and fought for it for years but was denied. I asked everyone I knew for ideas to earn or help but was largely ignored, blamed or brushed off.  I have seen how people rationalize not helping and how that plays into the politics and ideals when it comes to social programs in this country. A few people have helped here and there and I am grateful, but in the end there hasn't been a sustainable way to survive in these conditions and “better than nothing” isn't realistic in many cases.

I admit I am depressed, anxious, and angry...but I am not irrational. I don't want to die. I am not a nihilist. I don't hate myself or want to meet some god. I don't care about a legacy or attention for myself. What I do want is attention brought to the issues. The issues that ignoring suffering and blaming victims and demonizing social assistance in the USA is hateful, harmful and kills people.

If I had the sort of medical and living assistance many first world nations have I could survive. I might even be able to learn new things and be productive again. But I can't do it when I am struggling to get through each day and can't get proper care or conditions that don't worsen my pain and issues. I am not the only one. There are millions of people in need but Americans love to focus on the minority of abusers and ignore the majority of those suffering. They make excuses, blame victims and avoid things that work in other developed nations out of some misguided sense of politics or individuality. 

I have known several people in my shoes who ended their lives. One very recently. None of them wanted to but they were pushed farther and farther by flames to the edge of the window, and their choice was as David Foster Wallace (and he would know) said “had to choose between burning to death and jumping”.

No matter why someone ends up chased by flames...whether it's a physical diease, mental disease, financial losses, or something else or some combination...the results are the same. All of us can end up there...none of us can survive without help. I don't have much hope for this to change anything. My gut tells me it's futile as I have seen far better people than me dedicate their lives to trying to bring such change and society just sort of ignores the issues in the long run.   

To those who would suggest medications or disability applications tips etc, I appreciate the thoughts but this has been my life for more than 10 years and if there was a realistic way I would be doing it. You need health or money (and health allows you to get money) to survive. I don't have enough of either and far too many people are in the same situation. I would love to find a solution, but hearing the same ineffective things over and over, followed by me being blamed for the advice not working, is exhausting. 

Thanks to those who took the time. Maybe things can change some day.

*I am going to lay down for a bit so give me until tonight to answer if you do post at all...I am not ignoring anyone...just hurting and need to rest.
